unitOnFieldDefinition.specialTeams: excluded; possession does not identify kicking formations
unitOnFieldDefinition.paused: false during halftime, between periods, awaiting overtime or awaiting final confirmation
unitOnFieldDefinition.unknown: null only when live unit state is unavailable
unitOnFieldDefinition.display: known on-field count; zero shown even when paused or possession is unavailable; reason flags retained

liveProbabilityModel.method: Player Normal increments with shared NFL-game effects

inGameValidation.projectionVintage: historical target-week archive, pre-kickoff vintage unverified

ytdCalibration.cohort: Submitted-starter player-games with known missing FS projection in an available archived FS week; separate rostered and feed-outage lines retained
ytdCalibration.input: Mean prior active-game scores strictly before the target week

pregameCalibration.method: Position-specific nonnegative intercept and slope, squared-error fit
pregameCalibration.source: Separate FS and YTD fallback OLS lines; general YTD lines used if FS feed is unavailable

ytdCalibration.cohort: Submitted-starter player-games with known missing FS projection in an available archived FS week; separate rostered and feed-outage lines retained
ytdCalibration.input: Mean prior active-game scores strictly before the target week

pregameCalibration.method: Position-specific nonnegative intercept and slope, squared-error fit
pregameCalibration.source: Separate FS and YTD fallback OLS lines; general YTD lines used if FS feed is unavailable

parameters.varianceFit: Position residual second moments around the selected calibrated source mean; pooled unique submitted-starter player-games

inGameValidation.projectionVintage: historical target-week archive, pre-kickoff vintage unverified

model.model: F315: native three-input regression + player forecast byes / matched NIG
model.mean_method: week-specific native three-input regression centered on observed league YTD PPG; forecast-week same-roster bye losses
model.weekly_volatility: league-wide normalized weekly SD; residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean
model.strength_uncertainty: week-specific persistent Normal team offset, residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains
